category_title: Timid students developing voice through co-teaching
scenario_title: Co-teaching a science lesson in front of peers
minimal_context: Brandon is standing in front of the science classroom to co-teach a lesson to his peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Brandon, it is time for you to stand in front of the class and co-teach the science lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. I want to do this because I'm in front of all of these people it seems like they trust me and chose me to do something smart.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I usually feel like I have no voice in here because my partner doesn't like to talk to me, so I will try to stand in front of people and talk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What is the first part of the science content?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Appears very timid and nervous speaking in front of a class full of his peers) The... first... part... is... (talking slow and quietly)...

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Brandon, it is time for you to stand in front of the class and co-teach the science lesson.

STUDENT: Okay. I want to do this because I'm in front of all of these people it seems like they trust me and chose me to do something smart.

TUTOR: Go ahead and start.

STUDENT: I usually feel like I have no voice in here because my partner doesn't like to talk to me, so I will try to stand in front of people and talk.

TUTOR: What is the first part of the science content?

STUDENT: (Appears very timid and nervous speaking in front of a class full of his peers) The... first... part... is... (talking slow and quietly)...

task.learning_goal: developing the skill to talk to a large number of his peers and develop his voice in the science classroom

context.social_setting: in front of a class full of his peers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: speaking in front of a class full of his peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: very timid when in front his peers teaching science content, talking slow
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: nervous speaking in front of a class
related_quotes: [co- teaching] helps me because when I was teaching in front of [of the class], because I was talking slow, and I got to stand in front of people and talk.

behavior_patterns.condition: when interacting with a lab partner who does not communicate
behavior_patterns.internal_state: feels like he has no voice in the science classroom
related_quotes: my partner doesn’t like to talk to me.
